svg.aria-label: Rush Labs, an applied AI lab. Open-source tools for open models. Four released tools and a research model for fine-tuning, retrieval and local AI, each with its code, tests and benchmarks in the open. Built with PyTorch, CUDA, Hugging Face, llama.cpp, ONNX Runtime, Ollama.
